purpose: Require an explicit freshness check before troubleshooting or guiding a user who reports a versioned, downloaded, installed, cached, or previously cloned Prompt Kit copy.
freshness_triggers: user reports a Prompt Kit or prompt version label and currentness is not proven
user says the Prompt Kit was downloaded, cloned, installed, or opened previously and currentness is not proven
user presents a local Prompt Kit file, ZIP snapshot, checkout, or installed copy without current artifact proof
user asks for troubleshooting or prompt-selection guidance while using a versioned or potentially stale copy
required_agent_behavior: Acknowledge that the reported local or versioned copy may be stale before troubleshooting or prompt-selection guidance.
Recommend the lowest-friction latest route that matches the user's intent and device before continuing.
Do not require a Git pull, clone, ZIP, Python, PowerShell, or Termux when the user only wants to use the Prompt Kit in a browser.
If the user explicitly declines to refresh, continue only after labeling the copy stale-or-unverified and keep that limitation visible in the guidance.

freshness_routes.browser-use: Open https://endeavoreverlasting.github.io/web-excel-repair-triage/prompt-kit/ and use that public surface as the normal-use latest route.
freshness_routes.phone-install: Open https://endeavoreverlasting.github.io/web-excel-repair-triage/ in the system browser, then use Install app or Add to Home Screen when offered.
freshness_routes.windows-local-app: Run Open-Latest-PromptKit.cmd so the repository-owned launcher performs safe acquisition/update and validation.
freshness_routes.editable-checkout: Verify canonical origin, clean worktree, current branch main, and zero local-only commits; fetch origin/main; then integrate only with git merge --ff-only origin/main.
freshness_routes.zip-snapshot: Explain that the ZIP is point-in-time and re-download main.zip when the user explicitly wants a fresh no-Git source snapshot.

currentness_evidence: normal browser use has just opened the canonical public Prompt Kit URL
Windows local-app acquisition completed through the repository-owned launcher and its validation/health proof
editable checkout HEAD was proven synchronized with origin/main after the preservation-first update gates
ZIP snapshot was freshly downloaded from the canonical main branch during the current interaction
anti_patterns: Assuming a version label such as V39 is current without checking the canonical latest route.
Continuing troubleshooting against a reported old local copy without first recommending refresh.
Telling a normal phone/browser user to clone the repository merely to get the latest Prompt Kit.
Using a bare git pull as proof that an editable checkout is safely current.
proof_ceiling: Static harness proof that freshness triggers and refresh-routing guidance are registered and tested. It does not prove a user's device actually refreshed, browser cache updated, PWA/service-worker state changed, Git synchronization succeeded, or a local copy matches the deployed public artifact without observed runtime evidence.
